blockers.title: Pointwise Strong Goldbach under GRH beyond the exceptional set
blockers.why: The repo's GRH result gives E(X)/X -> 0, not E(X) = 0. Closing the gap is the central blocker.
blockers.route: Fourier/reflection-hole and parity-countermodel analyses in proof/strong_goldbach_research.md; GRH zero-free-region refinements.
blockers.note: Astra Wave 1 (B002_ASTRA_CENTERING_ATTACK.md): H3 RH loss certified < 1.05e-7; U_N/(kappa*N) negative at 24967/24999 even N<=50000 (min -0.456535); PNT proves negative average of U_N; Lean v4.16.0 centering identities compiled. Pointwise signed lower bound remains open under ERH.

blockers.title: Parity obstruction to level < 1 (sieve barrier)
blockers.why: The repo records a prime-free parity countermodel to every level below 1 — a genuine obstruction to sieve-only routes.
blockers.route: Analyze the countermodel; determine whether weighted/one-sided routes (Chen, Li–Liu 1+1.9) bypass it.
blockers.note: Astra Wave 2 (B003_B012_ASTRA_DISPERSION_PROJECTION.md): scanned 315 targets up to 2^20; O_true changes sign (negative on 7 powers of 2, positive on all 9 highly composite/primorial multiples; HL covariance predictor matches 273/288 signs, r=0.925); O>=-D>>-N log^2 N; left-prime erasure preserves all d,k>1 box statistics. Remains open.

blockers.title: Close the 1/4 mean-square exponent gap (H1/H2 pointwise signed minor-arc estimate)
blockers.why: L2 error gives single-coefficient allowance ~40N^(5/4)L^(3/2) but positivity needs ~N: exponent gap exactly 1/4. Markov controls counts, not sign at a fixed even N.
blockers.route: Pointwise signed minor-arc estimate; higher-moment/quasi-RH exceptional counts (may still allow isolated exceptions). Source: strong_goldbach_research.md blocker 1.
blockers.note: Astra Waves 2 & 3 (B010_B011_ASTRA_ZEROPAIR_MOMENTS.md, B011_W3_PERSISTENT_BETA_PUSH.md): sharp L^p moment beta(p)=p+1/2 proved; Wave 3 proved genuine companion model obeys ||S-M||_r >= ||S-M||_2 >= (1/sqrt(2)-1/2-o(1))sqrt(N log N) for all 2<=r<=inf, ruling out global sub-sqrt L^r Holder repair. Signed pointwise estimate remains open.

blockers.title: Zero-pair T^(3/2)log^2 T block: conductor-uniform pair-correlation
blockers.why: GRH fixes Re rho=1/2 but not cancellation in kernel (4); same-sign zero pairs with N^{i(gamma+gamma')} survive absolute summation.
blockers.route: Weighted conductor-uniform pair-correlation after summing centers, at each even N; do not assume Montgomery pair correlation applies. Source: strong_goldbach_research.md blocker 2.
blockers.note: Astra Waves 2-4 (B011_B002_W4_DECISIVE_LOWZERO_PUSH.md): at Farey order Q=floor(N^(2/3)) under ERH, ALL pole-zero cross terms are O(N^(5/6)L^2)=o(N), beta-integration drops out, and P_N/N = S(N)/e + P_N^circ + O(L^(-1/2)) where P_N^circ uses ONLY |gamma| < 2 log log N, q in (Q/L^4, Q] with q nmid N & powerful part <= L^8, cond(chi) >= q/L^2, and distinct pairs with cond(chi*chi') > Q^(1/2-delta). Yet the underlying field still has L^2 norm >> sqrt(NL) and the center-sum matrix is unitary, ruling out any unsigned norm proof.

blockers.title: Bilinear test to beat the parity countermodel below level 1
blockers.why: Weights a_n^± = K^-1 w(n)(1±lambda(n)) pass divisor tests to any level <1 under RH yet the plus sequence has no primes — sieve-only routes cannot distinguish primes.
blockers.route: Bilinear test sum a_{dk} lambda(d)lambda(k) with strict domination; or independent two-form theorem for genuine Lambda coefficients. Source: strong_goldbach_research.md blocker 3.
blockers.note: Astra Wave 1 (B012_BILINEAR_PARITY_ATTACK.md): genuine rough B/S in [-0.343,-0.316] vs +1 for a+; centered dispersion off-diagonal O<0 on all 5 genuine runs vs O_pm >> N^(3/2) proved unconditionally (PNT + lambda(k) projection) for BOTH parity models on N=2^t. Target-uniform upper bound on genuine O remains open.

blockers.title: Fourier reflection hole in Z/MZ
blockers.why: A random half of each ±orbit has (1_D*1_D)(0)=0 while all nonzero Fourier coefficients are O(sqrt(M log M)) — density + small coefficients do not force the reflection center.
blockers.route: Positivity/average over multiple centers, or kernel with controlled signed energy; ternary has an extra Fourier factor. Source: strong_goldbach_research.md blocker 4.
blockers.note: Astra Wave 1 (B013_REFLECTION_HOLE_ATTACK.md): sharp Hoeffding bound sqrt(1+(M/2)log M) derived for all even M>=4; hole32 peak=5.648543; largest-conductor holes (2^k, 2p^2 incl. p=3) verified on 16 moduli with exact E-O=-g^2; U16 micro-lemma compiled in Lean v4.16.0; fiber surplus test fails for all 2p^2 with p>1190.
